dos: Prep breakfast + soak water the night before
Cook one base meal for the family; full-fat milk for kids
Sip water through the workout; coconut water after
Daily sunscreen + 7–8h sleep + hydration for skin
Weigh weekly; measure inches every 2 weeks
donts: Don't put kids on Mummy's deficit or give them adult supplements
Don't treat detox waters as belly-fat burners
Don't skip strength for extra cardio
avoid: Mithai, sugar in chai, cold drinks
family: Cook ONE base dish for everyone
Kids eat to appetite — no deficit
Kids: no adult supplements — ask a paediatrician
